source: Thermostat.ev.SetpointChange; Thermostat.feat.TEVT; SetpointChange.SystemMode is constrained to heat and cool; SetpointChange.Occupancy conformance is OCC. This row matches thermal.setpoint.occupied_heating only when SystemMode is heat and occupancy is occupied. When OCC is absent, the unoccupied heating setpoint is absent and a heat SetpointChange is that occupied-heating target. Cool with occupied occupancy, heat with unoccupied occupancy, cool with unoccupied occupancy, and any other SystemMode are withheld on this row. Those combinations are not written as thermal.setpoint.temperature_setpoint.
